target_customer: Individual job seekers in India and the US who pay for resume building, reviews and interview prep
problem: Job seekers struggle to create effective resumes, cover letters and LinkedIn profiles. Hiration offers a low cost software product plus paid reviews to fix this.
business_model: B2C subscription and paid services (resume review and rewrite)

founders.name: Anish Raj Sikka
education: B.Tech, IIT Delhi (YC page says IIT D)
MBA, IIM Calcutta (YC page says IIM C)
previous_startups: ZO Rooms (founding team; raised $30M+ and was acquired in under two years per YC page)

founders.name: Aditya Sharma
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in People Matters coverage of the 2021 round; the YC page lists only Sikka.

technical_complexity.rationale: Template based resume generation plus later AI rewriting. Mostly standard web product engineering with content operations.

defensibility.rationale: Many resume builders existed and templates are easy to copy. Brand and SEO were the main edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later AI resume tools from Canva, Teal and Rezi (which entered India in December 2022) increased competition; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: The YC page cites 100k+ new active job seekers added each month, which is the company's own claim. No third party demand evidence dated 2020 was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Outcome language such as 2X more interviews and 3x faster.

branding.community_and_virality: Site claims 2M+ job seekers served, self-reported and unverified.

brand_strength.rationale: Funding press covered the company, but no sources show brand-driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Hiration is still operating and reports millions of users. After YC in early 2020 it raised about $3 million in August 2021 from Prime Venture Partners, Venture Highway and Y Combinator to scale in India and the US. No later round was found, and the company moved from resume builder to an AI career platform.
notes: Round label: coverage calls it a fresh round; Caplight calls it seed, so stage is recorded as other. The YourStory page returned 403 on fetch, so the amount, investors and date come from search results listing several outlets (People Matters, Inc42, YourStory, FinSMEs, Prime Venture). Some outlets omit Y Combinator. Rs 21 crore is about $3M, and one aggregator shows $2.83M. No competitor with a source dated near early 2020 was found; Rezi.ai entered India in December 2022 and is excluded. Founding year is 2017 per the YC page; one profile says 2016. The headquarters is reported inconsistently between New Delhi and Bengaluru.
